title: Electrical Part-Age Credit Schedule for Collision and Structural Workmanship Warranties
content:
**Credit.** Under the Workmanship Warranties, an electrical part-age credit is taken off the electrical diagnostic charge on a Collision Lifetime Workmanship Warranty or Certified Structural Lifetime Warranty. The electrical part-age credit follows the whole calendar months by which the coverage's time in service, from the issued date to the charge date, exceeds the plan's electrical parts months:

| Months by which time in service exceeds the plan's electrical parts months | Electrical part-age credit |
|---|---|
| at least 1 and at most the recent-part months, 6 | the recent-part credit, USD 10.00 |
| more than 6 and at most the aging-part months, 12 | the aging-part credit, USD 5.00 |
| any other span | no electrical part-age credit |

## Schedule by plan

The plan's electrical parts months are 12 under the Collision Lifetime Workmanship Warranty and 24 under the Certified Structural Lifetime Warranty. In whole calendar months of time in service from the issued date to the charge date:

| Plan | USD 10.00 credit | USD 5.00 credit | No credit |
|---|---|---|---|
| Collision Lifetime Workmanship Warranty (12 months) | 13 to 18 months | 19 to 24 months | 12 months or fewer; 25 months or more |
| Certified Structural Lifetime Warranty (24 months) | 25 to 30 months | 31 to 36 months | 24 months or fewer; 37 months or more |

## Boundary cases (hypothetical, Collision Lifetime Workmanship Warranty)

- 12 whole months in service: exceeds the parts months by 0; no credit.
- 13 months: exceeds by 1; USD 10.00.
- 18 months: exceeds by 6; USD 10.00.
- 19 months: exceeds by 7; USD 5.00.
- 24 months: exceeds by 12; USD 5.00.
- 25 months: exceeds by 13; no credit.
